test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The road which __connecting__ the two states is overcrowded.
solution:
The correct answer is: **connects**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"connecting"** means joining or linking two or more things together. (जोड़ना)

 
 
• **Example:** The bridge is connecting the two towns.
 
 
 
• **"Connects"** is the simple present tense form of the verb "connect" and is used to describe an action that happens regularly or is a general truth. (जोड़ता है)
 
 
• **Example:** This road connects the city to the highway.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct substitution for "which connecting" is "connects."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **connects**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Connected** (जुड़ा हुआ): Past tense of connect, indicating that the action was completed in the past.

 
 
• **Example:** The two cities were connected by a new railway line last year.
 
 
 
• **Has connecting** (जोड़ रहा है): Incorrect tense usage in this context.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: The road has connecting the two states.
 
 
 
• **Have connected** (जुड़े हुए हैं): Incorrect subject-verb agreement in this context.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: The road have connected the two states.
